desc:
🌱 Welcome to Steal to Grow a Garden  🌱

🏁 Sneak into the Hall and grab a seed. Rarer zones contain rarer seeds!
🌻 Plant it in your garden and watch your tree make money every second!
⚡ Collect BEST Trees, Plants and fill your Index!
📏 Mutations help you earn more money!
🧬 Spend Star Coins at the Tree Mutation Machine to roll a new mutation on your Trees!
🌧️ Live events: Thunderstorm, Earthquake, Meteor shower!

👍 Like the game & join the group!

Remember, your garden keeps making money even while you're offline 💤
